speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma (likely Nodular Sclerosis subtype given supraclavicular node, B-symptoms, elevated LDH, and leukocytosis).

The description of a fixed, non-tender supraclavicular mass combined with significant B-symptoms (night sweats, weight loss) and lab findings of high LDH and elevated WBC is classic for advanced-stage lymphoma. I have requested the necessary imaging to confirm the diagnosis and stage the disease.
